name: archfiend of the dross
mana cost: {2}{B}{B}
types: creature phyrexian demon
power toughness: 6/6
static: flying
replacement: CARDNAME enters with four oil counters on it.
triggered: at the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from CARDNAME. then if it has no oil counters on it, you lose the game.
triggered: whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, its controller loses 2 life.
